We'll set up a regression problem to predict the surface roughness:

def run_module(ctx):
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    from matplotlib import pyplot as plt
    from scipy import stats
    import sklearn
    from sklearn import metrics, model_selection, linear_model, cluster, decomposition, preprocessing, ensemble, tree, neighbors, svm, mixture
    from matplotlib import pyplot as plt

    from sklearn import linear_model, ensemble
    from sklearn import linear_model, model_selection
    from sklearn import model_selection
    from sklearn import preprocessing
    from sklearn.feature_selection import GenericUnivariateSelect
    from sklearn.feature_selection import RFE
    from sklearn.feature_selection import SequentialFeatureSelector
    from sklearn.preprocessing import KBinsDiscretizer
    import numpy as np
    
    
    data = pd.read_csv('../datasets/3dprinting.csv')
    data
    
    x = data.loc[:, :'fan_speed (%)']
    x = pd.get_dummies(x)  # convert categorical to one-hot!
    
    y = data.loc[:, 'roughness (microns)']
    
    model = linear_model.LinearRegression().fit(x, y)
    print( 'R2 = ', model.score(x, y) )
    ctx['data'] = data
    ctx['model'] = model
    ctx['tensors']['x'] = x
    ctx['tensors']['y'] = y
